'''Walads''' was an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bresallis]]. Bresallis was plagued by a criminal underworld ran by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. Ambassador Walads opposed the Hutts, trying to disrupt their businesses whenever possible. He was about to make a speech to the government on the subject, but was cut short when the Hutts hired [[Brahle Logris]] to assassinate him.
